'''Gokim Keeg''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
A [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] at the beginning of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Gokim Keeg was part of the minority of Jedi that believed that [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] was being honest when he proclaimed that a second [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] was in control of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. Keeg was considered an iconoclast by [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Halagad Ventor]], who rejected the "[[Second Sith theory]]," and rejected his beliefs and instead believed that Dooku had simply been referring to himself during his talk with [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. Keeg shared his views with a churlish companion and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]].
